coverage_limits: Bleu Sector 2, Bleu Sector 10 and Magenta Sector 5 have no numbered-sector section in the reviewed RotomLabs tables. Preserve existing leads or unknown coverage, not an empty-roster assertion.
District-wide street/plaza rows and Bisafans' generic random-spawn list are not evidence for every numbered sector.
Alpha subheadings are not ordinary Walking rows and do not establish fixed versus random Alpha status. Only the four specifically cross-checked unresolved Alpha leads are added here.
Gift and Static Encounter sections are separate. Fennekin, special Weedle, Mawile, Carbink and Diancie are not added to ordinary Walking rosters from those headings.

Scatterbug/Spewpa Meadow labels describe the source's pattern grouping; this reconciliation retains species identity without claiming a distinct visible form. Vivillon and flower form claims remain explicitly attributed.
Specialist source agreement corroborates the stated membership, not independent game observation, exact spawn position, universal conditions or a full area census. Some source levels disagree.
The source page URLs and authored observations are retained. Artifact hashes identify our review files, not unretained original website bytes. No new game imagery or website layout is copied.
